independent_retained_byte_audit.method: Independent source, bytes, receipt, output and blob-structure review; no runner import, compiler invocation, test replay or ELF decoding

limits: Type compatibility does not validate a hook claim, pointer publication or native instruction/cache synchronization.
Historical eligibility and source literal search do not establish current exclusive ownership.
Native +4 continuation rows do not provide anonymous island/trampoline unwind metadata.
A separate SDK-compatible permanent-slot and authoritative terminal capture-state composition remains to be implemented and tested.
scope: Offline SDK output-slot type, source publication/lifetime and one service continuation-row review

corrections_before_publication: Distinguish pre-lock claim validation from mutex-protected overlap/installation.
Attribute exact firmware matching to earlier loader checks.
Describe set_ready(bool) as reusable offline-helper interface, also present in production configuration.
Scope pointer atomic accesses to the selected compiler/target contract.
